sentences.text:
The present second bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the petitioner who is in custody in connection with FIR No.100/2019, Police Station Kherapa, District Jodhpur for the offence punishable under Sections 8/15 & 25 of NDPS Act, Sections 332, 353, 307,
420, 467, 468, 469, 471 & 411 of IPC and Section 3 of the P.D.P.P. Act.
2. Heard learned Sr. Counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
3. Learned Sr. Counsel for the petitioner submits that after the rejection of the first bail of the petitioner on 19.04.2024, charge- sheet in the case has been filed.
Learned Sr. Counsel submits that co-accused persons, namely, Ghewar Ram S/o Shri Chhoga Ram, Gopal @ Gorap Ram, Bhawani Singh & Ghewar Ram S/o Rawat Ram have been granted bail.

He further submits that the case of the present petitioner stands on a similar footing to the [2024:RJ-JD:28795] (2 of 2)
[CRLMB-8408/2024] case of co-accused Ghewar Ram S/o Shri Chhoga Ram who has been enlarged on bail by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 16.12.2022.

He, therefore, prays that Bhepa Ram @ Beba vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:28795) on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/107255197/
1 the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.

entities.text: Bhepa Ram @ Beba vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:28795)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. The learned Public Prosecutor opposes the bail application but he is unable to distinguish the case of the present petitioner vis-a-vis the case of the co-accused persons who have been enlarged on bail.

5. Having regard to the peculiar facts and circumstances of the case and considering the fact that case of the present petitioner is identical to the co-accused aforesaid who have been enlarged on bail, this Court deems it just and proper to release the petitioner on bail.
6. Consequently, the present second bail application is allowed.

It is ordered that the accused-petitioner Bhepa Ram @ Beba S/o Ramkishan arrested in connection with FIR No.100/2019, Police Station Kherapa, District Jodhpur, shall be released on bail; provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees:
One Lac Only) with two sureties of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees: Fifty Thousand Only) each to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
